templates.title: Level blockout
templates.description: Greybox kit: floor, ramp to a platform, steps, walls and cover blocks
templates.author: theprototype

templates.title: Physics playground
templates.description: Static floor and ramp, a dynamic cube pyramid, dominos and a bouncy ball — press P to simulate
templates.author: theprototype

templates.title: Architecture shell
templates.description: Room shell with a door and window opening, columns and a half roof to block out interiors
templates.author: theprototype

examples.title: Lighthouse island
examples.description: A small primitive-built lighthouse on an island — an example of composing simple shapes
examples.author: theprototype

games.title: Towers
games.description: Co-op crate stacking: grab the wooden crates, build the tallest tower on the glowing pad, climb to the stars. Your best height is saved. Press P to pause or restart.
games.author: theprototype

games.title: Stars Room
games.description: A zero-gravity glass room full of glowing crystal stars. Knock them with your hands in VR or walk into them. Start a round to light every star against the clock, or just play.
games.author: theprototype

games.title: Football
games.description: VR football: hit the floating ball with your hands, a ball through the other gate is a goal. Pick a side, Start, five goals wins. Colocation-ready.
games.author: theprototype

games.title: Jam Room
games.description: A small studio: a piano into a speaker, a beat lab (transport, drum machine, sampler pads) and a pedal chain into a mixer — all cabled. Press Start, then ▶ on the Transport, and keep the band going for eight bars. Play with the mouse; your best tempo is saved.
games.author: theprototype

games.title: Dungeon Realms
games.description: Co-op dungeon crawl: a seeded five-floor dungeon, gems to collect, portals that unseal when enough are found, and a dragon’s hoard at the top. Join as Player 1 / 2, walk it together.
games.author: theprototype

games.title: Untangle
games.description: A planar-graph puzzle on a flat board or around a globe: drag the dots until no edges cross. 30 levels per mode that unlock as you solve them; every peer sees and solves the same board.
games.author: theprototype

games.title: Waves
games.description: Wave survival: hold the goal against waves of enemies walking in from the spawn points. Knock them down; the round ends when the last wave falls.
games.author: theprototype

contests.title: Make a mirror
contests.description: Rebuild the sculpture on the left as its mirror image on the right of the glowing line. The faint ghost is the answer — hide it to test yourself.
contests.author: theprototype

contests.title: Follow the beat
contests.description: A 120 BPM track, a Conductor whose clip marks every beat and bar, a light that pulses on the beat and three cameras that cut on the bars. Press Start, then make the scene move. Track: "Happy Experimental Ethno Jazz Vocal Instruments Dance Cinematic Music 120Bpm Mastered" by szegvari (freesound, CC0 1.0).
contests.author: theprototype
